verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding: the committed rustdoc no longer contains measured speedup ratios, thread-by-thread timings, or a crossover estimate, and it explicitly leaves canonical performance validation outstanding. The remaining numeric descriptions are structural algorithmic pass/work counts rather than benchmark results. The derivation plan satisfies the stated stable-sort invariant, both parallel and sequential wave execution materialize sources before use, and the differential test exercises the real TripleStore build against the replaced independent full-radix implementation across empty, duplicate-heavy, constant-column, multi-byte, and Id-boundary inputs. The ignored timing helper makes no performance assertion and labels its output non-canonical.
